service: ocs-backend

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: provided
  region: us-east-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  memorySize: 2048
  timeout: 900  # Adjusted to 30 seconds to comply with HTTP API limits
  environment:
    STAGE: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
    ENVIRONMENT: "production"

  ecr:
    images:
      ocsbackend:
        path: ./
        platform: linux/amd64

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - http://localhost:3000
        - https://getessence.app
        - https://www.getessence.app
        - https://main.d1lkh6gn3xrn6w.amplifyapp.com
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
      allowedMethods:
        - OPTIONS
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE
      allowCredentials: false

  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - dynamodb:*
      Resource: "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:322521590770:*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - s3:*
      Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
      Resource: "*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
      Resource: "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-1:322521590770:*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - lambda:InvokeFunction
      Resource: "arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:322521590770:function:${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-*"
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - ses:SendEmail
        - ses:SendRawEmail
      Resource: "*"
    # Add permission for CloudWatch Events
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - events:PutRule
        - events:PutTargets
      Resource: "*"

functions:
  app:
    image:
      name: ocsbackend
    events:
      - httpApi: 
          path: /{any+}
          method: '*' 
    environment:
      ENVIRONMENT: "production"
      STAGE: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}

  parseFeedsScheduled:
    image:
      name: ocsbackend
    events:
      - schedule: cron(0 6 * * ? *)  # Run at 6:00 AM UTC every day
      - schedule: cron(0 15 * * ? *)  # Run at 2:30 PM UTC every day
    environment:
      ENVIRONMENT: "production"
      STAGE: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
    maximumRetryAttempts: 0  # Set to 0 to disable retries for asynchronous invocations
